answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the oasis of a task receipt, and the mesa is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the nectar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
